categories.name: Non-Critical Admission
categories.description: Admission of the patient to a non-critical inpatient ward (Admission NC), realizing the goal of admitting a patient to an inpatient ward. This contributes toward standard post-discharge recovery outcomes.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared XOR alternative Admission NC (id=15) based on the goal model decomposition. Sample variants such as V0008, V0070, and V0066 realize this alternative directly.

categories.name: Intensive Care Admission
categories.description: Admission of the patient to an intensive care unit (Admission IC), realizing the goal of inpatient admission while incurring a negative contribution (-25) to minimizing time-to-treatment due to specialized handling requirements.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared XOR alternative Admission IC (id=16) as defined in the goal model. Sample variants such as V0605, V0317, and V0068 reflect patient cases routed through intensive care.
